place.name: Bolzano
place.description: Bolzano, also known as Bozen (see § Names), is the capital city of South Tyrol, officially the province of Bolzano/Bozen, in the autonomous region of Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol in northern Italy. With a population of 106,901, as for 2026, it is the largest city in South Tyrol and the third-largest in historical Tyrol.
